english: Not supposed to be in here, lady.
current_chinese: 女士，你不该在这里。

english: Then you've been very lucky for decades. Your luck has run dry today.
current_chinese: 那你几十年来可真是走运，今天你的好运走到头了。

english: There's a lot of Zerenski's men on patrol.  I'd stay off the lower roof if I were you
current_chinese: 泽伦斯基有很多手下在巡逻。要是我是你， 就不会走下层屋顶

english: See for yourself. I believe it's time to do what you do. I'll do what I do and meet you later.
current_chinese: 你自己看吧。该你大显身手了。我去忙我的， 待会儿见。

english: Who ARE you?!!
current_chinese: 你到底是谁？！

english: Ahh... so you're the mysterious assassin? You've certainly been on a... spree, haven't you?
current_chinese: 啊……所以你就是那个神秘刺客？ 你确实已经大开杀戒了……不是吗？

english: We weren't even sure you were real until poor Delinda turned up without her head.
current_chinese: 直到可怜的德琳达被人发现身首异处， 我们才相信真有你这么个人。

english: You've intrigued me, but fear I must attend to other events, so I bid you good night, little sister. Make yourself at home.
current_chinese: 你让我很感兴趣，但恐怕我必须去处理别的事了， 所以晚安了，小妹妹。把这里当自己家吧。

english: See for yourself. I believe it's time to do what you do. I'll do what I do and meet you later.
current_chinese: 你自己看吧。该你大显身手了。我去忙我的， 待会儿见。

english: Severin: these thugs are coming out of the woodwork. Rayne, you're going to have to find another way out. And be careful...you may have company.
current_chinese: 塞弗林：这帮暴徒到处都是。莱恩，你得另找出口。 小心点……可能有客人要来。

english: Severin: Very creative, Rayne.
current_chinese: 塞弗林：很有创意，莱恩。

english: Severin: We're picking up heavy activity at an old meatpacking plant called Ray Ray's Meats...
current_chinese: 塞弗林：一座叫雷雷肉联厂的旧肉类加工厂里有大批敌 人在活动……

english: Severin: Just get over there and see what you can find out.
current_chinese: 塞弗林：过去看看，尽量查出点线索。

english: Severin: Well you're going to have to find a way past it.
current_chinese: 塞弗林：那你得想办法绕过去。

english: Severin: That's it. You can get to the main loading docks through the hallway. Watch your step.
current_chinese: 塞弗林：就是这儿。穿过走廊就能到主装卸区。 脚下小心。

english: Severin: Rayne, don't go, it's definitely a trap. I'm reading loads of his men hiding in the rooftops. You've done what you needed to do. Just find another way to the streets and let this guy go.
current_chinese: 塞弗林：莱恩，别过去，肯定是陷阱。 我探测到屋顶上藏着很多手下。你该做的已经做了， 另找条路上街，别追他了。

english: Severin: Rayne, it's not woth it....
current_chinese: 塞弗林：莱恩，不值得……

english: Severin: Forget about it. We've got a situation down on the streets. The police are on the street and are getting massacred. These guys seem to be closing up shop and moving on.
current_chinese: 塞弗林：别管他了。街上出事了：警察正在遭屠杀。 这帮家伙似乎在收拾东西撤离。

english: Severin: Keep following the rooftops and you should find an area with street access. Get down there before they disappear.
current_chinese: 塞弗林：继续沿屋顶走，应该能找到通往街面的地方。 趁他们还没跑远，赶紧下去。

english: Minion: Jesus Christ! Let's go! enough of this! We gotta get cross town!
current_chinese: 喽啰：老天爷！走了！玩够了！咱们还得穿过城区！

english: Minion: What the hell, just take her down!
current_chinese: 喽啰：管他呢，干掉她！

english: Severin: OK, Rayne. They're headed down the street to the crosstown tunnel.
current_chinese: 塞弗林：好了，莱恩。他们沿街去了穿城隧道。

english: Severin: Listen, I'm at the old Center Street station up the road. It looks like they're corralling all the civilians here.
current_chinese: 塞弗林：听着，我在前面那座旧中心街车站。 他们好像把平民都赶到这里。

english: Severin: Rayne, do you copy?
current_chinese: 塞弗林：莱恩，听得到吗？

english: Severin: Word on the street is that the disappearances have skyrocketed. like all the street trash fell into a hole in the ground.
current_chinese: 塞弗林：街头传闻失踪人数暴涨， 好像街上的流浪汉全掉进了地洞。

english: Severin: They couldn't have gotten out that fast. Rayne, I think you might....
current_chinese: 塞弗林：他们不可能跑得那么快。莱恩， 我觉得你可能……

english: Aw, didn't they tell you? District's closed, honey. Adult swim. Everybody outta the pool...
current_chinese: 哎，没人告诉你吗？这片街区封了，亲爱的。 成人专场，闲人清场……

english: Severin: Very creative, Rayne.
current_chinese: 塞弗林：很有创意，莱恩。

english: Severin: We're picking up heavy activity at an old meatpacking plant called Ray Ray's Meats...
current_chinese: 塞弗林：一座叫雷雷肉联厂的旧肉类加工厂里有大批敌 人在活动……

english: Severin: Just get over there and see what you can find out.
current_chinese: 塞弗林：过去看看，尽量查出点线索。

current_chinese: 喽啰：老天爷！走了！玩够了！咱们还得穿过城区！

english: Minion: What the hell, just take her down!
current_chinese: 喽啰：管他呢，干掉她！

english: Severin: No way. They couldn't have gotten out that fast. Rayne, I think you might ... .
current_chinese: 塞弗林：不可能。他们没那么快撤走。莱恩， 我想你可能……

english: Kestrel: Tsk. Too bad, pretty. Woulda been a pretty mess you made...
current_chinese: 红隼：啧，真可惜，美人。 差一点就能看见你摔个稀巴烂了……

english: Kestrel: Hah! You talk big. You wanna talk big to my boys? I'll just watch.
current_chinese: 红隼：哈！口气不小。 跟我的小伙子们也耍耍嘴皮子吧？我看着就行。

english: Kestrel: Want to, but too much else to do!
current_chinese: 红隼：倒是想，可还有太多事要忙！

english: Civilian: Where are you taking us?
current_chinese: 平民：你们要带我们去哪儿？

english: Minion: Let's keep it moving people.
current_chinese: 喽啰：都动起来。

english: Minion: Come on! Move! Move! Move!
current_chinese: 喽啰：快！走！走！走！

english: Kestrel: You meet these boys, Pretty? They the most loyal happy to give they all for the Mistress!
current_chinese: 红隼：见过这些小伙子吗，美人？他们最忠心， 乐意为女主人付出一切！

english: Kestrel: Once they give all, Mistress gonna put 'em back together better than ever. Right boys?
current_chinese: 红隼：等他们献出一切，女主人就会把他们拼好， 变得更强。对吧，小伙子们？

english: Kestrel: Oh, these boys don't talk, Pretty. No tongue. Cut out themself. These boys just do. Go, boys!
current_chinese: 红隼：哦，这些小伙子不说话，美人。没舌头， 自己割的。他们只管行动。上吧，小伙子们！

english: Severin: You see a door anywhere nearby? It should lead straight to the West waterpump room. That pump's gonna need to be shut down.
current_chinese: 塞弗林：附近看到门了吗？应该直通西侧泵房。 得把那台泵关掉。

english: Kestrel: My boys? Where they gone? Tsk tsk. Time to teach you respect, girl.
current_chinese: 红隼：我的小伙子们呢？都哪儿去了？啧啧， 该教教你什么叫尊重了，姑娘。

english: Kestrel: Oh, I'm gonna teach you this pretty can be cut off, too! You learn THAT fast, all right!
current_chinese: 红隼：哦，我要让你明白，这张漂亮脸蛋也能割下来！ 你马上就会懂了！

english: Severin: Alright, the water level is dropping. Low enough, anyway. The primary water treatment facility is just at the other side of the access tunnel..
current_chinese: 塞弗林：好了，水位下降了。反正够低了。 主水处理设施就在检修隧道另一头。

english: Minion: Psst! Quiet... I hear someone coming.
current_chinese: 喽啰：嘘！安静……我听见有人来了。

english: Minion: Get it ready... load up the heat.
current_chinese: 喽啰：准备好……给重家伙装弹。

english: Minion: I know how to load it... just shut up.
current_chinese: 喽啰：我知道怎么装弹……闭嘴吧。

english: Minion: I don't hear nothin... maybe it was rats...
current_chinese: 喽啰：我什么都没听见……兴许是老鼠……

english: Minion: Oh yeah? Rats in silver-steel stiletto heels?
current_chinese: 喽啰：哦？穿银钢细高跟鞋的老鼠？

english: Roarrrr!!
Servants!! ATTEND ME!!!
current_chinese: 仆人们！！过来伺候！！！

english: Lord Kagan? My love, have you returned? Have you brought the children?
current_chinese: 卡根大人？我的爱人，你回来了？ 你把孩子们带来了吗？

english: No. Your blood smells of him, but you are not him. Where are my children?
current_chinese: 不。你的血有他的气味，但你不是他。 我的孩子们在哪儿？

english: Brother Xerx took them. Promised to return them to Slezz. Where ARE they?
current_chinese: 泽克斯兄弟带走了他们。他答应过， 要把他们还给斯莱兹。他们到底在哪儿？

english: Lying. You're lying. I can smell it. Return my CHILDREN!!!
current_chinese: 撒谎。你在撒谎。我闻得出来。把我的孩子还回来！！ ！

english: Come closer, Kagan-Not-Kagan. I'm starving.
current_chinese: 靠近些，像卡根又不是卡根的人。我饿极了。

english: Urggh! I am undone!!!
current_chinese: 呃！我完了！！！

english: Sounds like the wings have stopped. She's vulnerable Rayne. Get inside and cut out the heart.
current_chinese: 翅膀好像停了。现在她毫无防备，莱恩。钻进去， 把心脏挖出来。

english: Rayne? Climb up to the upper level...
current_chinese: 莱恩？爬到上层去……

english: Let's go, bloodsacks. In the cars! Now!
current_chinese: 走，血袋们。上车！马上！

english: Move it! No shoving! Plenty room for everybody!
current_chinese: 快走！别挤！人人都有位置！

english: Move 'em out. Next stop, Wetworks.
current_chinese: 把他们运走。下一站，血液工厂。

english: Where'd she come from? Hold the train and cut her off!
current_chinese: 她从哪儿冒出来的？别让列车走，拦住她！

english: Was just leaving! To a better world, Pretty!
current_chinese: 正要走呢！去更好的世界，美人！

english: You still in play, Pretty? Thought maybe you got left behind in the noise...
current_chinese: 还在玩吗，美人？ 我以为你已经被那些响声埋在后头了……

english: HA! True-true! We very loud tonight! Don't care! World needs be scared. We taking over! We coming out!
current_chinese: 哈！没错没错！今晚我们闹得很响！不在乎！ 世界该害怕了。我们要接管一切！不再躲藏！

english: Oh, you see. We like a big bang. Like a big surprise, too!
current_chinese: 哦，你会看到的。我们喜欢大爆炸，也喜欢大惊喜！

english: True-true! You big surprise, Pretty-play so rough. You wanna play our side, maybe?
current_chinese: 没错没错！你真是个惊喜，美人，玩得够狠。 要不要来我们这边玩？

english: Tch. OK. You too tough, then. Stay tough, Pretty...
current_chinese: 啧。好吧，你够厉害。继续撑着，美人……

english: Off now! But you get yours soon, Pretty.
current_chinese: 走了！不过你的报应也快了，美人。

english: Huh. That was a pretty frantic call for one little girl.
current_chinese: 哼，就一个小姑娘，至于在无线电里慌成那样吗？

english: Maybe. But the long guns ain't shootin'. Be careful.
current_chinese: 也许吧。可重枪都不响了。小心点。

english: There more of you around, lady?
current_chinese: 女士，你还有同伙吗？

english: Oh my God-what's going on here?!
current_chinese: 我的天，这到底怎么回事？！

english: Faster we lock this section down the faster we can get the hell outta here.
current_chinese: 越快封锁这一区，咱们越快能滚出去。

english: We're getting' our asses handed to us here.
current_chinese: 咱们被打得屁滚尿流了。

english: Retreat! Drop the exit! Do it now!
current_chinese: 撤退！炸塌出口！快！

english: Dhampir? I knew we had an intruder, but I thought you'd at least be fullblood...
current_chinese: 半吸血鬼？我知道有闯入者， 可还以为至少是个纯血……

english: You're the one that took dear brother Zerenzki from us?
current_chinese: 就是你夺走了我们亲爱的泽伦斯基兄弟？

english: Interesting. And what did you hope to prove?
current_chinese: 有意思。你想证明什么？

english: We chose a bad place to fight, little assassin.
current_chinese: 小刺客，这可不是打架的好地方。

english: That's loud. Sounds like you've found the club proper.
current_chinese: 真响。看来你找到俱乐部的主场了。

english: Minions can't work a Bloodfield only dhampir. The Kestrel must be the one you've gotta take out to dissipate the field.
current_chinese: 喽啰不会施展血界，只有半吸血鬼会。 得杀了那个红隼，结界才会消失。

english: Minions can't work a Bloodfield only dhampir. The Kestrel must be the one you've gotta take out to dissipate the field.
current_chinese: 喽啰不会施展血界，只有半吸血鬼会。 得杀了那个红隼，结界才会消失。

english: Helicopter Pilot: Alright, that's everyone, I'm out of here.  But not without a little parting gift...
current_chinese: 直升机驾驶员：好了，人都下去了，我撤了。 不过先留点告别礼物……

english: Minion: Musta' gotten her by now.  Let's go check it out.
current_chinese: 喽啰：这会儿应该干掉她了吧。过去看看。

english: Minion: Aw Shit - Get her!
current_chinese: 喽啰：妈的！抓住她！

english: Hey, we gotta lock this place down! Sun's coming up. Vampire patrols are all in for the day.
current_chinese: 喂，得把这里封起来！太阳出来了， 吸血鬼巡逻队都回来躲白天了。

english: There is a service corridor beneath that giant tesla coil. Find the controls to lower the safety fence so you can access the maintenance hall.
current_chinese: 那台巨大特斯拉线圈下面有条检修走廊。 找到控制装置，降下防护围栏，就能进入检修通道。

english: Yeah, that's a negatory, good buddy-- That son of a bitch is fifteen feet tall. Can't we call in a foreman?
current_chinese: 不行，老兄——那混蛋足有十五英尺高。 不能叫个工头来吗？

english: Aw, he's not hurting anything. Let him play.
current_chinese: 嗨，他又没弄坏什么。让他玩吧。

english: Get in there, ya skells!
current_chinese: 进去，你们这些废物！

english: That's the last of 'em. Get this cage outta here. And lock the gate so none of 'em crawl back out.
current_chinese: 最后一批了。把笼子运出去，锁上门， 别让他们爬回来。

english: Severin: What's that sound?
current_chinese: 塞弗林：什么声音？

english: Traujer Elite: Your Father has ordered your death.
current_chinese: 特劳格精锐：你父亲下令要你死。

english: Better than getting thrown out a forty story window into sunlight, bitch. I'm going...
current_chinese: 总比被从四十层楼的窗户扔进阳光里强，婊子。 我要去……

english: Raaargh! Do you miss the SUN!??
current_chinese: 吼！想念太阳了吗？！

english: The Vesper Shard made itself at home in my flesh. It has been... unpleasant.
current_chinese: 暮星碎片在我的血肉里安了家。 这个过程……并不愉快。

english: Well, that's that. You're done. Kagan and the siblings are dead. How does it feel?
current_chinese: 好了，结束了。你做完了。 卡根和那些兄弟姐妹都死了。感觉怎么样？

english: Mutters in vampirish.
current_chinese: 用吸血鬼语低声嘟囔。

english: Severin: You saw the trees in the Park. And the dessicated animals. The Shroud obviously causes some aberrant effects on nature.
current_chinese: 塞弗林：你看到公园里的树和那些干瘪的动物了。 暗幕显然让自然界产生了某种变异。

english: Goddamn it, be careful with those. You'll wake up the dead.
current_chinese: 妈的，小心点。你要把死人都吵醒了。

english: Sorry boss...
current_chinese: 对不起，老大……

english: Dead zoo keeper. Too cold to eat.
current_chinese: 死了的动物园管理员。太凉，没法吃。

english: How can it be cold? It's still moving...
current_chinese: 怎么会凉了？还在动呢……

english: Dhampir: Idiots. The right amount of heat will remedy the situation.
current_chinese: 半吸血鬼：蠢货。给点够劲的火就解决了。

english: Dhampir: I smell something... besides burnt insects
current_chinese: 半吸血鬼：我闻到了什么……不只是烧焦的虫子。

english: Severin: Walk softly, Rayne... I don't think you want to disturb these new friends.
current_chinese: 塞弗林：脚步轻点， 莱恩……你肯定不想惊动这些新朋友。

english: Shadow Legion: [Whispered Vampirish]
current_chinese: 暗影军团：[低声说吸血鬼语]

english: Shadow Legion: [Whispered Vampirish]
current_chinese: 暗影军团：[低声说吸血鬼语]

english: Ephemera: I thought Ferril removed you, dhampir.
current_chinese: 埃菲梅拉：半吸血鬼，我还以为费里尔已经解决你了。

english: Ephemera: Oh, you saw that, did you? Yes, she had to go. Afraid there's only room for one traitor at the top.
current_chinese: 埃菲梅拉：哦，你看见了？对，她非死不可。 顶上的位子，只容得下一个叛徒。

english: Ephemera: Oh, we'll find that out soon enough, I think. Maybe our father will tell me just before I carve him open. If he wakes up first...
current_chinese: 埃菲梅拉：我想很快就会知道。 也许在我剖开父亲之前， 他会告诉我——如果他能先醒过来的话……

english: Severin: Worse than that. You did everything right, Rayne--you took out the Tower. But we failed to stop the Shroud itself.
current_chinese: 塞弗林：比那还糟。你没做错什么，莱恩， 你摧毁了塔。但我们没能阻止暗幕。

english: Severin: Vampires are free to walk in daylight. They're unstoppable.
current_chinese: 塞弗林：吸血鬼可以在白天自由行走了，谁也拦不住。

english: Severin: Brimstone's gone. Just offline or completely wiped out, I can't tell. Result's pretty much the same either way. I'm out of a job.
current_chinese: 塞弗林：硫磺会没消息了。是通讯断了还是全军覆没， 我不知道。反正结果差不多，我失业了。

english: Severin: Of course. But I've been thinking we could try to escape to the wilderness.
current_chinese: 塞弗林：当然。不过我也想过，也许能逃到荒野去。

english: Severin: Between us, with our skills, it's likely we could survive. Maybe find other survivors...
current_chinese: 塞弗林：凭咱俩的本事，应该能活下来。 也许还能找到别的幸存者……

english: Severin: We're going to continue to track Kagan...
current_chinese: 塞弗林：我们会继续追杀卡根……

english: Severin: ... even though civilization has crumbled in...less than four hours... and all hope is definitely, unquestionably lost...
current_chinese: 塞弗林：……尽管文明在……不到四个小时里……就崩 溃了，所有希望也确确实实、毫无疑问地破灭了……

english: Severin: Yeah. I'm terrified that it will.
current_chinese: 塞弗林：是啊，我怕得要命。

english: Severin: Superb. Very impressive. Now be quiet and look over there. What do you think about that?
current_chinese: 塞弗林：绝了，精彩极了。现在安静，看那边。 你觉得那个怎么样？

english: Ferril: Revenge is a weapon! Wield it as a shining sword to avenge your mistress!!
current_chinese: 费里尔：复仇就是武器！像挥舞利剑一样， 用它为你们的女主人报仇！！

english: Severin: "Vengeance this, Revenge that." See what that sounds like?
current_chinese: 塞弗林：“报仇这个，复仇那个。”听听像不像你？

english: Ferril: Fly, you angels of destruction, you devils of justice, fly and kill and fucking die for me!
current_chinese: 费里尔：飞吧，毁灭的天使，正义的恶魔！飞去杀戮， 他妈的为我去死！
